amount.description: Aggregate amount in minor units. Preview shape: it carries no lines and no tax rates, so the reply cannot be allocated. Use `lines` for anything that ends up in a fiscal document.

lines.description: The quote's lines with their tax rate. With lines the reply also carries `allocation` (per line, adding up to the discount exactly) and `by_tax_rate` (ADR-0210). `amount`, if also sent, must equal their sum.

line_ref.description: The caller's own reference for the line; echoed back in the allocation.

amount.description: Line amount in minor units, on the quote's tax basis.

tax_rate_pct.description: The line's tax rate as a percentage. A RATE, not money: 21, 10, 0, 12.5.

tax_basis.description: Optional per-line basis. Lines that disagree are rejected (`mixed_tax_basis`).

Basis of the whole quote: `inclusive` = the amounts already carry the tax · `exclusive` = they are the taxable base. Omitted, it is inherited from the hub and then defaults to `inclusive` (ADR-0210); the reply always states which.

rules.description: null = load every active rule; a list of UUID strings = only those (active); a list of dicts = inline rules (preview, no DB lookup).
